subject: Risk & Compliance
title: GDPR and Cyber Compliance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on GDPR and Cyber Compliance.

hook.text: GDPR can fine companies 4% of global revenue for data breaches. For big tech, that's billions of dollars.

buildup.text: The EU's General Data Protection Regulation sets strict rules on how companies handle personal data.

discovery.text: GDPR requires breach notification within 72 hours. Companies can no longer hide incidents for months.

twist.text: GDPR applies to any company serving EU citizens — even if the company is based elsewhere.

climax.text: GDPR forced global companies to rebuild data practices. It became the template for privacy laws worldwide.

punchline.text: One EU law. Global impact. Privacy got teeth.

quiz.question: What is the maximum GDPR fine?
